charge_port.notes: Tesla's own connector (now NACS / SAE J3400) is used on all Tesla vehicles including the Model 3 (Wikipedia). Canadian and US cars alike.

supercharger_access.notes: Tesla's own Supercharger network, built for this connector (Wikipedia).

wheels.notes: Base-trim wheel on the cars.com page for that era. Carried over from a neighbouring model year on the same body; that year was not opened. Cars.com page shows RWD only; Long Range AWD is a sibling trim (18 inch standard per The Driven from April 2022).
The Driven (2022-04-26): 19 inch sport wheels an option on the Long Range (US$1,500 in the US); carried to 2023 by assumption.
